description: This file defines interfaces, enums, and function prototypes for retrieving and handling display information such as EDID data, HDR, HDCP, display dimensions, and callbacks for display state changes in a media or display management system.

methods.name: displayinfo_register_operational_state_change_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for operational state changes of the display info instance.

methods.name: displayinfo_unregister_operational_state_change_callback
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered operational state change callback.

methods.name: displayinfo_register_display_output_change_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for display output change events.

methods.name: displayinfo_unregister_display_output_change_callback
methods.description: Unregisters a display output change callback.

methods.name: displayinfo_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the display output.

methods.name: displayinfo_is_audio_passthrough
methods.description: Checks if audio passthrough is enabled.

methods.name: displayinfo_connected
methods.description: Checks if a display is connected.

methods.name: displayinfo_width
methods.description: Gets the width of the display in pixels.

methods.name: displayinfo_height
methods.description: Gets the height of the display in pixels.

methods.name: displayinfo_vertical_frequency
methods.description: Gets the vertical refresh rate of the display.

methods.name: displayinfo_hdr
methods.description: Gets the current HDR system of the display.

methods.name: displayinfo_hdcp_protection
methods.description: Gets the HDCP protection level of the display.

methods.name: displayinfo_total_gpu_ram
methods.description: Retrieves total GPU RAM in bytes.

methods.name: displayinfo_free_gpu_ram
methods.description: Retrieves free GPU RAM in bytes.

methods.name: displayinfo_edid
methods.description: Retrieves raw EDID data of the display.

methods.name: displayinfo_parse_edid
methods.description: Parses EDID data into structured info.

methods.name: displayinfo_edid_cea_extension_info
methods.description: Retrieves CEA extension info from EDID data.

methods.name: displayinfo_edid_vic_to_standard_timing
methods.description: Maps Video Identification Code (VIC) to standard timing info.

methods.name: displayinfo_width_in_centimeters
methods.description: Gets display width in centimeters.

methods.name: displayinfo_height_in_centimeters
methods.description: Gets display height in centimeters.

methods.name: displayinfo_is_atmos_supported
methods.description: Checks if Dolby Atmos is supported.

methods.name: displayinfo_dispose
methods.description: Closes cached display connection.
